name: What safety precautions are taken during gas line installation for a range?

mainEntity.name: What safety precautions are taken during gas line installation for a range?

acceptedAnswer.text: During gas line installation, safety is the top priority. A professional plumber will shut off the main gas supply to the property before beginning any work. They use specialized tools and techniques to ensure all connections are tight and leak-free. After installation, the line is thoroughly tested for leaks using appropriate equipment, often with a soap solution or an electronic leak detector, before the gas supply is restored. All work adheres strictly to local building codes and safety regulations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Safety precautions include shutting off the main gas supply, using specialized tools for secure connections, and thorough leak testing after installation.
